CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-night-folds, at head b4d0dd97425bd0d3ac4c19d6b21d9cb4b5ebdc1a. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch b4d0dd97425bd0d3ac4c19d6b21d9cb4b5ebdc1a for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-night-folds, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-night-folds <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-night-folds; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Group R10-NIGHT-FOLDS (Closes #2223), topic r10-night-folds, handoff tip b4d0dd97. The orchestrator's opener was refused by prepr (2026-10-21 08:2xZ): `## Unpinned sites` omits sites the diff adds, among them custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/coordinator.py:1090 GUARD_OFF, :1097 RETURN_DEL, :5091 CMP_BOUND*2, :5091 GUARD_OFF, :5157 GUARD_OFF (prepr prints the full list). Give each its disposition per fixer.md step 2 (pinned by mutation-autofix, a value check, or a written triage citing a re-runnable command, never a temp path). The handoff is about 106 commits behind main; the merge must keep the learner fix intact.
Before handing off: merge origin/main into the handoff (never rebase, never force; the push must fast-forward handoff/<topic>), re-take every body figure at the new head, give every Forward-carry/Friction line a `Carry: <GROUP>|#<issue>|dismissed: <reason>` that exists, answer every red check in `## Red checks` (nightly-status is main's: the replay loop_cpu_ratio budget, carried to R10-REPLAY-CAP), run `python3 tests/structure.py` and `bash tools/audit/seat/prepr.sh <body>` until prepr prints no REFUSE, then push the code and run body_push.sh. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
